Name: Ridgeside Rival Hearts - Jeric and Alex
Author: zoedoll
Description:
[size=5][b][size=5][b]Updated for 1.6 by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url]!

Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features.[/b][/size][/b][/size]

This mod adds some romance events for Jeric (from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]) and Alex, including an optional version where they get married, live together and adopt a puppy! Unlike my other Ridgeside Rival Hearts mod for Sam and Alissa, this has no option to back out and no platonic route - this is a one-way trip to Alex/Jeric town, no refunds.

[u]Events:[/u]

[list]
[*][b]First event: [/b][spoiler]Go into town on a sunny day between 9am and 5pm. Requires 2 hearts with Alex and Jeric.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Second event: [/b][spoiler]Go into Alex's house when he's there.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Third event: [/b][spoiler]Go to the Log Cabin Hotel between 9am and 6pm. Requires 4 hearts with Alex and Jeric.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Fourth event: [/b][spoiler]Go into Ridgeside Village after 6pm on a sunny Saturday.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Fifth event: [/b][spoiler]Go into Pelican Town between 10am and 6pm on a sunny Saturday.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Sixth event (married version): [/b][spoiler]Go to the Stardrop Saloon after 6pm on a Saturday.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Seventh event (married version): [/b][spoiler]Three days after the proposal you will get an invitation to their wedding in the mail. Go into Pelican Town on a Sunday day to trigger it![/spoiler]
[*][b]Eighth event (married version): [/b][spoiler]Go into Pelican Town on a sunny Saturday between 9am and 5pm.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[u]Configuration Options:[/u]
[list]
[*][b]Version[/b]: Dating, Married or Dynamic (version will switch from dating to married automatically over time)
[*][b]Polyamor[/b]y: Affects whether you can still date Jeric and/or Alex when they're married and gives you mini-events where they each react to the player dating the other (you'll only see which ever one happens first).
[/list]
If you aren't using the polyamory version, I recommend adding [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿ so you can see a platonic version of Alex's 10 heart event, and they're also working on a platonic version of Jeric's 10 heart event!

[u]Compatibility:[/u]
May have compatibility issues with anything else that edits Alex and/or Jeric's schedules; it has built in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6525]Please Remember My Birthday[/url]﻿ (English version). Will not work with versions of Ridgeside lower than 2.0, unfortunately.

Portrait/sprite mod used in screenshots: [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley]Diverse Stardew Valley Seasonal[/url]
